name: com.bite2u/bite2u
title: Bite2u
description: Find Bite2u restaurants, see menus with photos and prepare an order to pay on bite2u.com.

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find a restaurant to order food from (delivery or pickup) or to eat at, and the restaurant could be on Bite2u "Order here" (bite2u.com/order). Searches by restaurant name, city, cuisine or dish. Returns only restaurants listed on Bite2u, with whether they are open now, delivery/pickup/dine-in, rating and a link. Ordering and payment happen on the restaurant page at bite2u.com (the url field); this tool does not place orders.

query.description: What the user is looking for: a cuisine, dish or restaurant name (e.g. "pizza", "sushi", "burger"). Optional.

city.description: City or area, if the user said one. Optional.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, if known (e.g. "DO", "US", "ES"). Optional.

service.description: Only restaurants that offer this service. Optional.

open_now.description: true to return only restaurants open right now. Optional.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see the menu, dishes or prices of a restaurant returned by search_restaurants. Pass that restaurant's slug. Returns the menu by category with prices in the restaurant's currency, availability and allergens, plus order_url: the user completes the order and payment on that bite2u.com page.

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Use this when the user has chosen dishes from a menu returned by get_menu and wants to order. Pass the restaurant slug and the items (dish_id from get_menu, quantity, and size_id / options when the dish has sizes or option groups). It checks every item against the current menu and returns the lines, the subtotal in the restaurant's currency, any problem (for example a required option still to choose) and checkout_url: the restaurant page on bite2u.com with this basket already in it, where the user completes the order and payment. This tool does not place or charge the order.

slug.description: The restaurant slug from search_restaurants / get_menu.

size_id.description: Required when the dish has sizes: one id from its sizes.

options.description: Chosen options, per option group of the dish (see option_groups in get_menu).

note.description: Short note for the kitchen, only if the user asked (e.g. "no onions").
